_doc: TERMINAL MODES (Phase 067): the words and the art of the two terminal modes of bigville/tui. TUI_ART is the map mode's art: each map glyph of the agent view (agent_view.json MAP_GLYPHS) is drawn as a two-character tile, and each person and each thing has a glyph. The colours are recorded for a front end that draws colour; the plain text screen does not draw them yet. TUI_PROSE is the text mode's sentences: the room is written from the prompt packet (Phase 054), and every sentence here names only what the packet carries. Braces name the fields a sentence fills (narration_check.py rule: no digit outside a field). Nothing here is a world fact; all of it is presentation, and every glyph and word is a model choice (APPROX).

TUI_ART._doc: tiles: a map glyph (a key of MAP_GLYPHS) to its two-character tile and colour. people: the glyph for a person the resident knows by name (known) and for a stranger (stranger). things: the glyph for a thing the resident can act on. colours: the colour names a front end may use (self-test checks each colour is one of these).

TUI_PROSE._doc: The text mode's sentences. Each key names the fields it fills (domains/tui_check.py, TEXT_FIELDS). help is a list of lines. The words name no person, place or thing of the world: every name in a sentence comes from the packet.
TUI_PROSE.exits_none: No way on is known to you from here.
TUI_PROSE.things_none: There is nothing here you can act on.
TUI_PROSE.options_none: Nothing is open to you right now.
TUI_PROSE.unplaced: That is not a command here. Type a command from the list, a number from it, or say NAME: words.
TUI_PROSE.packet: The prompt packet this mode used:
help: Type a command, or a number from the list of things you can do.
Examples: go to a place you know; take a few of an item from a person; say NAME: words; smash a thing with a tool, hard; eat something; work at a recipe; wait.
Feelings: glance or attend looks into a feeling; press a place probes your body; strike NAME at PLACE hits someone.
look shows the room again. sheet shows your sheet. quit ends the session.
